sections.kicker: Prepared for kiimento by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: kiimento already wrote its best line. The site has not used it yet.
sections.keep: Your bio line, "Their childhood, told by them. Theirs to keep." It says why kiimento exists better than anything on the site.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.

pins.quote: Their childhood, told by them. Theirs to keep.
pins.what: Your Instagram bio holds the best line kiimento owns.
pins.why: It answers why kiimento and not another kids camera. The site never says it.
pins.how: Make this idea the first thing the site says, and build the rest of the page around it.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Parents compare kiimento to cheaper cameras on price, because the site gives them no other reason.

pins.what: On the site the same idea shrinks to a sticker on a photo.
pins.why: The reason to pay more than a toy camera reads as decoration.
pins.how: Put the promise in the headline instead of on a badge.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Parents scroll past the one line that justifies the price.

pins.area: Hello Kitty blind box unboxings fill most of the grid
pins.what: The grid mostly sells someone else's toy.
pins.why: Collabs bring reach, but a grid of someone else's character makes kiimento look like a toy shop.
pins.how: Keep collabs as moments and let the children's own photos be the grid.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: Every unboxing builds a licensed character instead of kiimento.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at kiimento. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.
